title: Why Toast Lands Butter-Side Down, Shoelaces Untie and Earbuds Tangle
description:
Your toast landing butter-side down isn't bad luck. A physicist worked out the real culprit: the height of your kitchen table.

Seven everyday annoyances, seven real experiments. Why do shoelaces come undone even when you tie them tight? Why do earbuds come out of your pocket in a knot? Why does dry spaghetti never snap into just two pieces? Why does the shower curtain creep in and stick to your legs? Why does spilled coffee dry as a ring, and why do the last cereal loops in your bowl clump together? Scientists measured every one of them, with treadmills, spinning boxes and two weeks of computer time.
